The monsters in an old non released movie come out of the movie and Tim and his friends in the real world and the movie must find a way to stop the monsters. The movie has bullies, geeks, parents, a love intrest, et cetera.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: McBride takes on the defense of a friend's young co-worker who is accused of robbing and murdering a woman who gave him a ride. McBride and Phil discover that the victim had multiple identities--and multiple simultaneous husbands . . .

programme.title: A Time to Remember
programme.desc: Poignant drama starring Dana Delany (ʻDesperate Housewivesʼ, ʻBody of Proofʼ) as a bohemian artist and single mother who returns to her childhood home for a Thanksgiving family reunion. She is hoping to reconcile with her prim and proper mother (Doris Roberts, ʻMrs Miracleʼ) with whom she has always clashed, but it gradually dawns on her that her mother is in the early stages of Alzheimerʼs disease, and the whole family has to face up to reality.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Family drama in which a young woman in 1950s America has her strong religious belief challenged by a series of traumatic events. The woman becomes involved with a local pastor, but her faith is tested when he is sent to serve in Korea.

programme.title: Straight from the Heart
programme.desc: A photographer in NYC has her refuse photos trashed. Later her boyfriend of 5 years offers his apartment key, not an engagement ring. Fixed by her matchmaker roomie, she meets a single rancher in Wyoming.

programme.title: Ordinary Miracles
programme.desc: Drama with Jaclyn Smith. A kindhearted judge agrees to take in a juvenile delinquent, hoping to help the youngster rehabilitate and face her troubled past.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Meteor is a disaster mini-series about a meteor on a collision course with Earth. After NASA discovers a giant meteor named Kassandra that threatens to erase humanity of the planet, astronomer Dr. Lehman and his assistant Imogene O'Neil must hurry to collect information about it. Lehman tragically dies along the way. Meanwhile, meteor showers are occurring worldwide causing panic. One of the towns hit by the meteorites is Taft in California. There, detective Jack Crowe is tries to find his ex partner Stark before he kills his daughter and father who is the sheriff of the town.

programme.title: The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
programme.desc: A fading actress's life is turned upside down when her rich husband dies unexpectedly while they are in Italy, and she sets off in a series of fleeting affairs set up by an ageing contessa.

programme.title: Selling Innocence
programme.desc: Mia Sampson (Sarah Lind), an unpopular girl, is approached at the mall one day to become a model. Even though she thinks modeling is shallow, she thinks it will be a better way to earn money than working for a sushi restaurant and goes to the agency. She poses for photographs which are to be displayed on an Internet website for "members only," supposedly so she can be scouted for other modeling jobs. As Mia's membership begins to go up, she begins feeling uncomfortable and also receives disturbing messages from a subscriber known as Gabriel. However, she continues to take shots and even participates in live video chats with the gentlemen of the site. Too late, Mia realizes that she is working for a pornography site and goes to a group called webwatch to uncover the operation. However, since the agency isn't doing anything illegal, the police can't do anything.

programme.title: Murder 101: College Can Be Murder
programme.desc: Murder mystery starring Dick Van Dyke (ʻMary Poppinsʼ, ʻDiagnos is Murderʼ) as an absent-minded and brilliant criminology professor and his real-life son Barry Van Dyke as the professorʼs friend, a former cop turned private investigator. When a college professor dies in mysterious circumstances, the father-and-son team investigate.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Mystery drama featuring John Larroquette as a hard-nosed cop turned compassionate defence lawyer, who specialises in lost causes. His latest client is a failed actress who became a call girl out of desperation and is now accused of the brutal murder of a prominent Beverly Hills madam. McBride's investigations reveal that the victim was a blackmailer as well as a procurer, which considerably lengthens his list of suspects.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Kukla, Fran and Ollie is an early American television show using puppets, originally created for children but soon watched by more adults than children. It did not have a script and was entirely ad-libbed.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Callie and Jasper develop an uncanny emotional connection to a young orphaned girl they chance upon in a park.

programme.title: The Maldonado Miracle
programme.desc: Family drama with Peter Fonda. In a small, dying town, the residents' faith is tested when a statue of Jesus seems to be shedding real tears of blood.

programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: Drama starring Doris Roberts and Judy Reyes. A wealthy widow opens up her house to a group of homeless people.

programme.title: Aces 'N Eights
programme.desc: Already taking a gamble settling in the uncharted west, the peaceful settlers of a town destined for railroad greatness suddenly find themselves being ruthlessly gunned down. With no law and order to be found, justice falls onto the shoulders of an elderly rancher (played by Ernest Borgnine) and an accomplished, but retired, gunslinger (played by Casper Van Dien).

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: The King and Queen of Moonlight Bay
programme.desc: 17-year-old Alison embarks on a mission: to find the father who abandoned her family when she was five years old, try to understand the past, and reestablish a relationship with the stranger she has never forgotten.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Historical drama series based on the escapades of Marco Polo: an infamous merchant-turned-explorer who travelled through Asia in the 13th century. Finding himself in the upper echelons of the Mongol Empire, the Venice-born Marco Polo embarks on a series of adventures in a world filled with war, revenge, tough decisions, love, loyalty, and betrayal. Starring Lorenzo Richelmy as Marco Polo.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Pirėjo „Olympiakos“ - Stambulo „Fenerbahce“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris" - Paryžiaus „Paris Basketball"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets
programme.desc: Drs. Hodges an Ferguson are always busy with a hospital full of patients from around rural Georgia. A Maltese puppy with failure to thrive is brought in. Dr. Hodges tries to rid aquarium fish of nasty parasites, after taking his son out for his first cow preg check. A surgery on a dog with a growth on his neck quickly turns tense when the dog starts bleeding profusely, and a pregnant goat and a horse with a stifle problem round out the episode.

programme.title: Wild Argentina
programme.desc: The coast of Patagonia is more than 1500 kilometers long and stretches from the Brazilian jungles to the southernmost point of South America. This coastline is home to some of the world's most extraordinary animal species. Here a bone-dry desert collides with a raging ocean. In this hostile and extreme area, animals must fight against the elements and each other to survive.

programme.title: Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Ibera is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Ibera finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Whether right whales, penguins or sea lions - for the birth of their young, many marine creatures are drawn to Argentina's nearly 5,000 kilometer coastline. From their very first breath, it's all about one thing for the little ones: survival. Orcas hunt for young sea lions with a special technique and seagulls fly merciless aerial attacks on baby whales. Extraordinary underwater images and impressive animal behavior make the film by Christian Baumeister a visual experience.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Predator v Prey

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Dragons Uncovered
programme.desc: The Komodo Dragon has captured our imaginations for over a century, yet so much about this incredible lizard remains a mystery. A creature with survival skills and physical characteristics seen in apex predators across the animal kingdom, and the ability to take down predators ten times its size. The secrets of the Komodo Dragon are revealed.

programme.title: Alaska's Deadliest: Predator Prowl
programme.desc: The biggest state in the union is also home to some of the deadliest predators. Alaska is one of the few remaining true wildernesses left on the planet. With its harsh environment, extreme cold and constant winter darkness it is not a place for the fainthearted. As springtime buds and the sun raises its head above the horizon, the state's predatory carnivores emerge on to the vast landscapes to hunt for food, with wolves, brown bears and wolverines dispatching prey with ease. In the waters along the coastline, giant orcas and salmon sharks track and kill their quarry while tiny terrors hide in the channels and make good use of their venomous attacks.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Dragons Uncovered
programme.desc: The Komodo Dragon has captured our imaginations for over a century, yet so much about this incredible lizard remains a mystery. A creature with survival skills and physical characteristics seen in apex predators across the animal kingdom, and the ability to take down predators ten times its size. The secrets of the Komodo Dragon are revealed.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why

Investigators are on the case, exploring the islands volcanic geography, exotic marine life, and human influence. Whats behind the mysterious occurrence, dubbed Sharktober?

Experts from across the globe join forces to investigate a variety of possible causes, including the islands unique marine landscape, the rise in aquatic watersports, and even a lone shark, gone rogue.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why
programme.desc: Charleston, South Carolina is renowned for its hospitality; but beginning in 2013, its resident sharks - werent quite as welcoming. Over two summers, five beachgoers are bitten within a 22-mile stretch of coastline. Scientists are on a mission to discover the reason behind the mysterious spike, examining the impact of beach rejuvenation, local reptile behavior, drought, and even a new shark species.

programme.title: Attack of the Big Cats

programme.title: Venom Files - Anatomy of a Snake Bite
programme.desc: Millions are bitten by snakes each year, yet their venom evolved for hunting, not harming humans. Explore the fascinating and deadly adaptations of the king cobra, black mamba, inland taipan, puff adder, saw-scaled viper, Mozambique spitting cobra and the fearsome boomslang. Journey from India's vibrant villages to Africa's wild bush and Australia's outback to witness how venom paralyzes, digests and protects. Discover why every snakebite is different — and how our worlds collide in surprising ways. Each snake's venom tells a story, engineered to hunt, defend and survive. But as humans and snakes collide, the chemistry that once kept balance now brings catastrophe. "Venom Files" reveals nature's deadliest assassins.

Animals are incredibly important to the people of the Yukon, and Dr. Oakley will do anything to keep them safe and healthy.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Apes: Battle Lines
programme.desc: Deep in the jungles of Africa, chimpanzees and gorillas, are living out epic dramas: warriors battle, kings fall, and battle lines are drawn. These unique, character-driven stories will touch your heart and blow your mind.

programme.title: Valley of the Wolves
programme.desc: Imagine a place that holds everything you've ever wanted. High slopes and good timber for cover and den sites. Water. Your very own herds to hunt and all the wide open space you need for the chase. But others of your kind also want this place. They will challenge you for it. How far will you go to defend it? In the northeast corner of Yellowstone, the wolves of the Druid Peak Pack have long held sway, but their power is waning. The old leaders of the clan cannot stand against the challenge of the invading Slough Creek Pack. But the conquering wolves will find this no safe haven. Here, they will meet a strange and terrible fate. And though in exile, the Druids will rebuild their clan and gather the strength to return. In this beautiful but dangerous place, there is bounty and cruelty, loyalty and banishment, triumph and death. This is the story of the battle for the perfect valley and the high price wolves will pay for paradise.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Apes: Battle Lines
programme.desc: Deep in the jungles of Africa, chimpanzees and gorillas, are living out epic dramas: warriors battle, kings fall, and battle lines are drawn. These unique, character-driven stories will touch your heart and blow your mind.

programme.title: Valley of the Wolves
programme.desc: Imagine a place that holds everything you've ever wanted. High slopes and good timber for cover and den sites. Water. Your very own herds to hunt and all the wide open space you need for the chase. But others of your kind also want this place. They will challenge you for it. How far will you go to defend it? In the northeast corner of Yellowstone, the wolves of the Druid Peak Pack have long held sway, but their power is waning. The old leaders of the clan cannot stand against the challenge of the invading Slough Creek Pack. But the conquering wolves will find this no safe haven. Here, they will meet a strange and terrible fate. And though in exile, the Druids will rebuild their clan and gather the strength to return. In this beautiful but dangerous place, there is bounty and cruelty, loyalty and banishment, triumph and death. This is the story of the battle for the perfect valley and the high price wolves will pay for paradise.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Apes: Battle Lines
programme.desc: Deep in the jungles of Africa, chimpanzees and gorillas, are living out epic dramas: warriors battle, kings fall, and battle lines are drawn. These unique, character-driven stories will touch your heart and blow your mind.

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. We'll also see penguin chicks daring to take the leap, an unlikely team of mismatched teenagers, and others learning how to weather and thrive in the coldest climates, thanks to their snowy homeschooling, some very dedicated parents, and a lot of trial and error.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Reptile Planet
programme.desc: Skittering, swimming and even gliding, over 12,000 species of reptiles roam the world. Crocs, turtles, snakes and lizards have ancestors as old as the dinosaurs and evolution as their friend. These cold-blooded creatures have adapted in clever and lethal ways, from armoured skin and poisonous venom to record-breaking bite force and even blood squirting eyes. This is Reptile Planet!

programme.title: Komodo Dragons
programme.desc: Mating, rivalry and the struggle to survive an imposing but unforgiving landscape as experienced by some of the most fearsome animals on Earth.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Apes: Battle Lines
programme.desc: Deep in the jungles of Africa, chimpanzees and gorillas, are living out epic dramas: warriors battle, kings fall, and battle lines are drawn. These unique, character-driven stories will touch your heart and blow your mind.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programme.desc: National Geographic filmmaker Bertie Gregory travels to the gateways to the poles to film wildlife in two of the harshest environments on the planet: South Georgia Island above Antarctica, and Canada's frigid North below the Arctic Circle. This is the story of Bertie's quest to capture these wild environments firsthand.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Not your average bunch of teenagers, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles have been expertly trained by their anthropomorphic rat sensei, Splinter, in the art of ninjutsu. Criminals of New York beware, beneath the streets of this concrete metropolis, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael are waiting to put their training into practice, battling evil forces within the city and restoring peace. From petty thieves, to evil overlords, to aliens of an unfamiliar kind, New York is safe in the hands of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!

programme.title: Sanjay and Craig
programme.desc: Does your neighbor have butt implants and a blueberry obsession? Can your best friend do ANYTHING without barfing? Welcome to Lundgren, where Sanjay Patel and Craig Slithers have the most rad-awesome adventures imaginable. From their collection of fart jars to their shared love of chicken wings, Sanjay and Craig are more than a boy and his pet snake… they're family! Ready for the ride? Buckle up your fart baby and grab some napkins because Sanjay and Craig are about to douse you in awesome-sauce. NOICE! See you at the Frycade!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When the group arrives at a small Earth Kingdom mining town, they see an earthbender, named Haru, who is practicing his ability, but he runs away when Katara tries to confront him about it. They soon learn that the Fire Nation has taken over the town, that earthbending is forbidden and all earthbenders are taken away to an offshore prison. However, when an elderly man is trapped in a collapsed mine, Katara urges Haru to use his powers to save the man's life, but then, the old man reports Haru to the authorities. Katara blames herself for his predicament and she vows to rescue him, but will she succeed?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Patty Caper: The Krabby Patty formula has been placed in a vault far away for safe keeping. When Mr. Krabs forgets the recipe, he gives SpongeBob the key to the vault and sends him on a train ride to retrieve the formula. But someone steals the key! It's a mystery-aboard-a-train story as SpongeBob tries to locate the culprit, and he does it with the unlikeliest of allies ... Plankton! Plankton's Regular: Plankton has a customer who loves his chum and eats at the Chum Bucket every day-and no one is more surprised than Plankton. Could this mean competition for the Krusty Krab?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Boating Buddies: In an attempt to get away from SpongeBob, Squidward drives off in his boat as fast as he can. But he's stopped in his tracks when he's pulled over by a cop and is ordered to go to boating school. Now Squidward has to sit next to SpongeBob in class all day long and SpongeBob couldn't be happier! The Krabby Kronicle: When Mr. Krabs notices that the citizens of Bikini Bottom love buying tabloid newspapers, he decides to begin another business venture-his own tabloid! He recruits SpongeBob as his writer, but SpongeBob doesn't feel comfortable making up stories about other people because that would make him a liar. But Mr. Krabs assures him that making up stories for the paper isn't lying, it's using your imagination! SpongeBob discovers that making up stories about the people in Bikini Bottom is a lot of fun-but the people he's writing about don't think so.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: Mo and Hashtag send a desperate plea to the family: to protect Terratronus at all costs or Starscream's plan will have major, destructive consequences. But Starscream is one step ahead of the Maltos, collecting nearly all the shards and taking Alex hostage for the remaining pieces. Leaving the Maltos no chance but to surrender, Starscream acquires what he needs for his plan to activate and raise Terratronus. While the Maltos put up the fight of their lives, Starscream successfully ignites Terratronus' spark...but with a corrupted Emberstone. The result: a chaotic energy-filled Terran Titan, capable of mass destruction. Robby and Mo are able to subdue Terratronus within a dome created from their sleeves' Prime Power, trapping inside Starscream and all the Decepticons with her.

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: When Draculaura secretly practices witchcraft, Clawdeen and Frankie help subdue the tater she brings to life. // Frankie needs help from Clawdeen and Draculaura to solve an ominous mystery of one of their brains' past lives.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

Will his best friends, Fee and Foo, be able to help Harvey tap into his wild side? From fighting a gang of squirrels to stealing bikes from Randl the grumpy raccoon, there are tons of adventures to be had in Bigbark Woods. Harvey, Fee and Foo are ready to cause some trouble and have a blast along the way.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wallykazam! is about the adventures of Wally Trollman and his pet dragon, Norville. Wally has a magic stick that makes words come to life; each story has a new set of magic words, and Wally uses these words to playfully transform the world around him.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: In New Jersey, the Good Grief community focuses on a holistic way of dealing with grief, where children can give in to rage in 'the volcano room,' and say goodbye to a dying teddy bear patient in 'the hospital room.' Over the course of a year, we follow the weekly meetings and get close to Kimmy, Nicky, Peter, Nora, Nolan, and Mikayla and their close companion: grief. It is sometimes heartbreaking, but also humorous, to experience the questions about life and death through their open and curious minds. Grief is high and heavy as a mountain, but it helps you understand what has happened, and that death is irreversible.

programme.title: Kamp Koral

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel film tratto da una storia vera, nominato a 6 premi Oscar. Il capitano di una nave americana assalita dai pirati si offre come ostaggio per salvare il suo equipaggio.

programme.desc: Dal regista di "Star Wars - Il risveglio della forza", J.J. Abrams, il reboot di un'altra leggendaria saga di fantascienza con un equipaggio di giovani star. A bordo della nave spaziale Enterprise, Kirk e Spock affrontano la loro prima missione. Oscar per il miglior trucco.

programme.desc: Colpo grosso in grande stile in una commedia con Morgan Freeman, Michael Caine e Alan Arkin. Tre amici di lunga data scoprono che i loro fondi pensione sono andati in fumo.

programme.desc: Missione impossibile per Liam Neeson in un action con Laurence Fishburne. Per salvare un gruppo di minatori intrappolati, tre camionisti devono attraversare un lago ghiacciato in primavera.

programme.desc: Simon West ('Con Air') dirige Nicolas Cage in un action con Josh Lucas e Malin Akerman. Durante una rapina qualcuno lo ha tradito, cosi' Will Montgomery si e' fatto qualche anno di carcere. Il bottino non e' mai stato recuperato, ma il suo vecchio socio e' convinto che Will sappia dove sia finito. E per recuperarlo ha un solo modo per convincerlo a collaborare: rapisce sua figlia Allison e la tiene prigioniera nel bagagliaio di un taxi. Se vuole rivedere la ragazza sana e salva, Will deve trovare 10 milioni di dollari in 12 ore.

programme.title: The Secret - Le verità nascoste
programme.desc: Noomi Rapace e Joel Kinnaman in un thriller sui crimini di guerra. USA, anni '50: convinta di aver trovato il suo carnefice, una donna sopravvissuta ai lager prende in ostaggio un uomo.

programme.desc: Commedia corale con Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Ricky Memphis, Carolina Crescentini e Stefano Fresi. I componenti di una famiglia entrano in crisi quando si ritrovano in una baita senza internet.

programme.title: The Kill Team
programme.desc: Nat Wolff e Alexander Skarsgard in un film tratto da una storia vera. Afghanistan: in un plotone incaricato di stanare terroristi, un soldato entra in conflitto con il suo superiore.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: Un Semplice Incidente
programme.desc: In Iran un uomo incontra per caso una persona che ritiene essere stata il suo torturatore. L'uomo nega strenuamente di essere coinvolto nella faccenda, cosa che insospettisce ancora di più chi lo ha riconosciuto.

programme.title: 8 Mile
programme.desc: Un giovane bianco di Detroit, nonostante i molti ostacoli, raggiunge il successo e diventa un rapper famoso.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Biopic di Aaron Sorkin con Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba e Kevin Costner. Dopo un infortunio, la sciatrice olimpionica Molly Bloom cambia vita e diventa la regina del poker clandestino.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Peter Weir racconta un'impresa disperata in un film con Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris e Colin Farrell. Evasi da un lager siberiano, un gruppo di uomini intraprende una fuga in condizioni estreme.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Tom Cruise da un racconto di Philip K. Dick. 2054: tre veggenti prevedono i crimini prima che accadano, ma qualcosa va storto e il capo della polizia viene accusato.

programme.title: After Yang
programme.desc: Colin Farrell nel film targato Sky Original, premiato al Sundance Festival. Nel futuro, i membri di una famiglia devono fare i conti con il malfunzionamento dell'androide che vive con loro.

programme.title: Edison - L'uomo che illumino' il mondo
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch, Tom Holland e Michael Shannon nel biopic su Thomas Edison. L'avvincente storia del pioniere dell'industria elettrica che ha cambiato la vita degli esseri umani.

programme.title: Questo O Quello - Steven Spielberg - Ep. 272 - Questo O Quello - Steven Spielberg
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano su alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista premio Oscar che ha fatto e continua a far sognare generazioni di spettatori.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: È stato tutto bello - Storia di Paolino e Pablito
programme.desc: Walter Veltroni racconta in un documentario la vita e la carriera di Paolo Rossi, uno degli eroi della nazionale italiana che trionfo' ai Mondiali di calcio del 1982.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: Jesse Eisenberg, Ed Harris e Clemence Poesy nel biopic su Marcel Marceau. Nella Francia occupata dai nazisti, il mimo si unisce alla Resistenza per salvare centinaia di bambini ebrei.

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Diretto da Craig Gillespie, il financial drama che ripercorre il caso GameStop, l'azienda salvata da un gruppo di investitori amatoriali a discapito di un gruppo di speculatori di Wall Street.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: Le musiche di Eddie Vedder e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Un diciottenne lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un intimo viaggio a contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Piccole donne
programme.desc: Rilettura di un classico diretto da Greta Gerwig con Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Laura Dern e Meryl Streep. La storia delle sorelle March nell'America della Guerra Civile. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana e Orlando Bloom nel kolossal ispirato al poema omerico. Dopo il rapimento di Elena da parte di Paride, Agamennone guida gli spartani contro i troiani.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: David Cronenberg dirige Viggo Mortensen in un thriller fra apparenza e realtà. Dopo aver ucciso 2 rapinatori per legittima difesa, un uomo si trova braccato da loschi individui.

programme.title: C'mon C'mon
programme.desc: Road movie con Joaquin Phoenix. Impegnato in un progetto di interviste itineranti, un giornalista stringe un forte legame con il nipote di 9 anni, in un viaggio attraverso gli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano su alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista premio Oscar che ha fatto e continua a far sognare generazioni di spettatori.

programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.title: Bombshell - La voce dello scandalo
programme.desc: Charlize Theron, Nicole Kidman e Margot Robbie nel biopic che ricostruisce il caso Roger Ailey. Il potente capo di Fox News viene accusato di molestie sessuali dalle sue dipendenti.

programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana e Orlando Bloom nel kolossal ispirato al poema omerico. Dopo il rapimento di Elena da parte di Paride, Agamennone guida gli spartani contro i troiani.

programme.title: La Grande Bellezza - Versione Integrale
programme.desc: Jep Gambardella ha sessantacinque anni e sprigiona un fascino che il tempo non ha potuto scalfire. È un giornalista affermato, che si muove tra cultura alta e mondanità in una capitale che non smette di essere un santuario di meraviglia e grandezza.

programme.title: C'e' Ancora Domani
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Paola Cortellesi, anche protagonista, entrato nella storia del cinema italiano. Roma,1946: Delia ha accettato la sua vita ma spera in un futuro migliore per la figlia.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Dramma sociale con Ben Affleck, Kevin Costner e Tommy Lee Jones. La vita di un agiato impiegato americano subisce un netto ridimensionamento quando perde il lavoro a causa della Recessione.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: L'ombra delle spie
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch in un thriller targato Sky Original tratto da una storia vera. 1960: un uomo d'affari inglese, spia per conto della CIA, viene coinvolto in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: The Young Messiah
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Anne Rice, una pellicola che ripercorre l'infanzia di Gesu'. A 7 anni il futuro Messia lascia l'Egitto per tornare a Nazareth dove scopre le sue vere origini.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: C'e' Ancora Domani
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Paola Cortellesi, anche protagonista, entrato nella storia del cinema italiano. Roma,1946: Delia ha accettato la sua vita ma spera in un futuro migliore per la figlia.

programme.title: Il capo perfetto
programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Dramma sociale con Ben Affleck, Kevin Costner e Tommy Lee Jones. La vita di un agiato impiegato americano subisce un netto ridimensionamento quando perde il lavoro a causa della Recessione.

programme.title: Free State of Jones
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Gugu Mbatha-Raw in un dramma storico. Guerra civile americana: un contadino si ribella ai soprusi dell'esercito confederato e crea uno stato indipendente.

programme.title: Downton Abbey - Il gran finale
programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga tratta dall'omonimo period drama televisivo, gli aristocratici Crawley affrontano lo scandalo pubblico scoppiato per il divorzio di Lady Mary, candidata a prendere in mano le redini della famiglia.

programme.title: The Michael Jackson Story
programme.desc: Dopo essere stato scagionato da ulteriori accuse di abusi, Jackson tenta un ambizioso tour di ritorno sulle scene. Quando muore improvvisamente, i gestori del suo patrimonio iniziano a monetizzare la sua eredità.

programme.title: The Michael Jackson Story
programme.desc: Il percorso di Michael Jackson da bambino prodigio a icona mondiale. Si analizza il genio, le polemiche, le prove e le tragedie che hanno plasmato, e continuano a dividere, la sua eredità.

programme.title: Red Rocket
programme.desc: Trovandosi in difficoltà a Los Angeles, l'ex pornostar Mikey Saber decide di tornare nella città natale di Texas City, dove nessuno sembra particolarmente entusiasta di rivederlo.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.title: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
programme.desc: Versione restaurata del celebre western di Sergio Leone, con Clint Eastwood, Lee Van Cleef ed Eli Wallach. Guerra di secessione americana: tre pistoleri inseguono un carico d'oro.

programme.title: Mystic River
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.title: Invictus - L'invincibile
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Morgan Freeman e Matt Damon in un biopic sportivo. Sudafrica, 1995. Per il presidente Mandela, la coppa del mondo di rugby è l'occasione per unire bianchi e neri.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al capolavoro diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood con Hilary Swank e Morgan Freeman. Un anziano e burbero allenatore di boxe trasforma una tenace ragazza in una campionessa.

programme.title: Cry Macho - Ritorno a casa
programme.desc: Road movie di ambientazione western di e con Clint Eastwood, dal romanzo di N. Richard Nash. Una vecchia gloria dei rodei accetta di riportare in Texas il figlio del suo ex capo.

programme.title: Ispettore Callaghan: Il Caso Skorpio È Tuo!
programme.desc: Uno spietato serial killer e' l'obiettivo dell'ispettore Callaghan, che ricorre ai modi poco ortodossi della giustizia privata pur di arrestare il criminale.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.desc: Il divertimento continua in compagnia dell'orco piu' simpatico del grande schermo. Shrek e Fiona dovranno affrontare i genitori di lei, poco propensi ad accettare un "mostro" come genero.

programme.title: Hop
programme.desc: Quando Fred, investe accidentalmente il coniglio pasquale, non ha la minima idea di quello che dovrà sopportare nei giorni successivi. Per salvare la Pasqua, infatti, dovrà prendersi cura del coniglio e sostituirlo.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Shrek Terzo
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo con il simpatico orco verde. Shrek eredita il trono del suocero, ma la vita di corte non fa per lui. Aiutato da Ciuchino e dal Gatto con gli stivali, cerchera' un sostituto.

programme.title: Shrek e vissero felici e contenti

I 'Troppo Cattivi' faticano a integrarsi in società a causa della loro reputazione e vengono coinvolti in una rapina ad alto rischio orchestrata da una nuova squadra di criminali: le Troppo Cattive.

programme.desc: Brillante commedia per tutta la famiglia con Giampaolo Morelli e Carolina Crescentini. Invidioso dei compagni di classe, Gabriele elabora un piano per far separare i suoi genitori.

programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Bambi - Una vita nei boschi

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Ricercati in Europa
programme.desc: Terza avventura e nuovo continente per il leone Alex, la zebra Marty, la giraffa Melman e l'ippopotamo Gloria, che si troveranno in Europa braccati dalla spietata agente DuBois.

programme.title: Caterina va in città
programme.desc: Commedia di Paolo Virzì con Margherita Buy e Sergio Castellitto. Giunta a Roma dalla provincia con i genitori, una timida tredicenne s'immerge nelle contraddizioni sociali della capitale.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - Amici per sempre
programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.title: Un film Minecraft
programme.desc: I formidabili Jason Momoa e Jack Black nel fantastico live action basato sull'omonimo videogame. Scaraventati attraverso un portale in un bizzarro paese delle meraviglie chiamato Overworld, quattro improvvisati avventurieri devono portare a termine una magica missione per tornare a casa.

programme.title: Il mio amico Finnick
programme.desc: Buffi personaggi in un divertente film d'animazione. La tredicenne Christine stringe amicizia con il paffuto mostriciattolo Finnick, con il quale indaga sul mistero che incombe in citta'.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Blockbuster di Halloween per tutta la famiglia. Il Conte Dracula organizza una festa per il compleanno della figlia Mavis, ma tra gli ospiti c'e' un intruso...

programme.title: Il gatto con gli stivali
programme.desc: Il celebre felino e' il protagonista dello spin-off della saga di Shrek. Dopo una rapina finita male, l'amicizia fra Gatto e Humpty Dumpty si e' rotta, ma il destino li fara' rincontrare.

programme.title: Mio fratello rincorre i dinosauri
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Isabella Ragonese in una pellicola di formazione di Stefano Cipani. Un adolescente si confronta con la disabilita' del fratellino, affetto dalla sindrome di Down.

programme.title: Moon il panda
programme.desc: Gilles de Maistre firma un inno alla bellezza della natura e all'amicizia tra uomo e animale. Cina: lo svogliato dodicenne Tian, sempre distratto dai videogame, viene mandato dalla nonna sulle montagne del Sichuan dove stringe un legame profondo con un cucciolo di panda.

programme.title: 100% Lupo
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione tratta da un libro per ragazzi. Freddy Lupin, discendente di una stirpe di fieri lupi mannari, si trasforma misteriosamente in un tenero barboncino.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: Lassie torna a casa
programme.desc: Avventuroso reboot del film datato 1943, che riporta sullo schermo il cane più famoso del cinema. Finito in una famiglia che non esita a maltrattarlo, Lassie riesce a scappare e affronta molti pericoli pur di ricongiungersi con il suo affezionato padrone Florian.

programme.title: Blade: Trinity
programme.desc: Wesley Snipes, Ryan Reynolds e Jessica Biel nel terzo capitolo della saga. Con l'aiuto dei Nightstalkers, Blade affronta Drake, una creatura che può resistere alla luce del sole.

programme.title: xXx - Il ritorno di Xander Cage
programme.desc: Vin Diesel nel terzo capitolo della saga action con Samuel L. Jackson e la partecipazione di Neymar. Un'arma tecnologica finita nelle mani sbagliate costringe Cage a tornare in azione.

programme.title: Operation Fortune
programme.desc: Action Sky Original di Guy Ritchie con Jason Statham e Hugh Grant. Una spia dell'MI6 e il suo team di agenti reclutano una star di Hollywood per una missione sotto copertura.

programme.title: Soldado
programme.desc: Stefano Sollima dirige Benicio Del Toro e Josh Brolin nel sequel di "Sicario". Ingaggiato dall'FBI, un uomo misterioso intensifica la guerra al narcotraffico fra Messico e Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Spy Game
programme.desc: Tony Scott dirige Robert Redford e Brad Pitt. Un agente segreto scopre che un collega sta per essere ucciso in Cina. L'indifferenza della CIA lo spinge ad agire da solo per salvarlo.

programme.desc: Ben Affleck nei panni di un personaggio con la sindrome di Asperger. Chris Wolff lavora come contabile forense ma segretamente cura le finanze di alcune organizzazioni criminali.

Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.desc: Brillante action di Guy Ritchie con Matthew McConaughey, Colin Farrell, Hugh Grant. La messa in vendita di una ricca attività illecita scatena gli appetiti di uomini senza scrupoli.

programme.desc: Avvincente action-comedy di David Leitch con Brad Pitt. Un sicario sale sul treno che collega Tokyo a Kyoto per rubare una valigia ma scopre di essere circondato da criminali.

programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Arnold Schwarzenegger nel reboot della celebre saga fantascientifica. Un cyborg viene spedito nel 1984 per uccidere la madre del futuro capo della resistenza contro i robot.

programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della saga action con Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, 'The Rock' e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic e Brian riuniscono la vecchia squadra per contrastare una banda di piloti criminali.

programme.desc: Paolo Virzì dirige Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Golino. Brianza: un incidente mortale segna il destino di due famiglie in un lento riaffiorare di segreti.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.desc: Ben Kingsley e Monica Bellucci in uno spy-thriller. Una donna avvenente e fatale complica i piani di un anziano agente del Mossad, alle prese con l'ultima missione della sua vita.

programme.desc: Una psichiatra piuttosto nota viene a sapere della morte di una delle sue pazienti. Presto, si convince che si tratti di un omicidio e decide di portare avanti la propria indagine per scoprire la verità.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: Due uomini trovano la più grande pepita d'oro mai scoperta e devono trovare un modo per dissotterrarla, ma il dubbio e l'avidità iniziano a farsi strada mentre i due mettono in atto il loro piano.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original al cardiopalma con Mel Gibson. Un conduttore radiofonico riceve in diretta la chiamata di un ascoltatore anonimo che minaccia di uccidere lui e la sua famiglia.

programme.desc: Tornato alla sua città natale nella speranza di riprendere a scrivere, Ben Mears scopre che è dominata dai vampiri e che l'unico modo per liberarla è entrare a far parte di una banda che sta tentando di sconfiggere queste creature.

programme.title: The Hanging Sun - Sole di mezzanotte
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jo Nesbo, Sky Original di Francesco Carrozzini con Alessandro Borghi. In fuga verso l'estremo Nord, John conosce Lea e Caleb, unica speranza di salvezza da un destino segnato.

programme.title: L'evocazione - The Conjuring
programme.desc: Patrick Wilson e Vera Farmiga nel primo capitolo della saga horror su una coppia di indagatori dell'occulto, che entrano in azione per fermare una terribile strega nel New England degli anni 70. La famiglia Perron - padre, madre e cinque figlie femmine - si e' appena trasferita in una nuova casa in campagna dove sono stati accolti da rumori inquietanti e strane apparizioni, che ben presto degenerano in vere e proprie manifestazioni paranormali. Terrorizzati, i coniugi Perron chiedono aiuto a due investigatori specializzati nella lotta contro presenze demoniache.

programme.desc: John Travolta in un thriller che scava nel torbido dell'ambiente militare. Un ufficiale deve scoprire chi ha ucciso la figlia di un generale. Dall'indagine emergono terribili retroscena.

programme.title: Il potere dei soldi
programme.desc: Robert Luketic dirige con maestria Gary Oldman e Harrison Ford in uno spy-thriller sullo spietato mondo dell'alta finanza a Wall Street. Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.title: Miss Sloane - Giochi di potere

Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Intervista A Valeria Golino E Saul Nanni
programme.desc: A tu per tu con i protagonisti de "La Gioia", diretto da Nicolangelo Gelormini, presentato alle Giornate degli Autori durante la 82esima Mostra Internazionale del Cinema di Venezia nel 2025. Un'occasione per conoscere aneddoti e curiosità dal set.

programme.title: Gli uccelli
programme.desc: Alfred Hitchcock dirige Tippi Hedren in un capolavoro assoluto del thriller. Gli abitanti di una cittadina vengono assaliti da stormi di uccelli che si sono coalizzati contro gli umani.

programme.desc: Elio Germano nello spiazzante thriller dei fratelli D'Innocenzo. Latina: un dentista vive in una villa con la sua famiglia. Un giorno, scendendo nelle cantine, incontra l'assurdo.

programme.title: Scomparsa
programme.desc: Amanda Seyfried a caccia dell'assassino in un thriller psicologico. Tornata a casa dal lavoro Jill scopre che sua sorella, Molly, e' stata rapita. Come poteva accadere a lei un anno prima, quando riusci' a fuggire dal misterioso aggressore che adesso sembra tornato in azione. Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.desc: Il sequel targato Blumhouse che riporta in vita la bambola killer: dopo un necessario upgrade, M3gan e' pronta per fronteggiare Amelia, un'altra bambola creata da una potente azienda con la stessa tecnologia ma piu' crudele e incontrollabile.

Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.
Silvio Soldini dirige Kasia Smutniak in una pellicola sulla responsabilita' verso il prossimo. La vita di un'avvocatessa viene sconvolta quando assiste alla morte di un giovane immigrato.

Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. programme.desc: In the 2005 Rome final, Rafael Nadal and Guillermo Coria went back and forth for over five hours in a breathtaking display of raw physicality and determination across five epic sets.

programme.title: Monte Carlo 2006: Nadal v Federer
programme.desc: Rafael Nadal and Roger Federer met in the first of three consecutive Monte-Carlo Masters finals, as the Spaniard overcame the then world number one Federer in four thrilling sets.

programme.title: Rome 2006: Nadal v Federer
programme.desc: In a five-hour final at the Foro Italico in Rome, Rafael Nadal refused to succumb to Roger Federer as one of tennis' great rivalries came to a head.

programme.title: Madrid 2009: Nadal v Djokovic
programme.desc: Revisit a three-set Madrid marathon as Novak Djokovic took Rafael Nadal to the brink during the 2009 semi-final.

programme.title: ATP Tour This Week
programme.desc: Step behind the scenes of men's professional tennis throughout the 2026 season on the ATP Tour with special features, interviews and much more.

programme.title: US Open 2010: Nadal v Djokovic
programme.desc: The moment Rafael Nadal completed the career Grand Slam by winning his first US Open title in 2010 against Novak Djokovic in New York.

programme.title: ATP Word Tour 2010: Nadal v Murray
programme.desc: Rafael Nadal's 2010 classic with Andy Murray in the semi-finals of the ATP World Tour Finals.

programme.title: Monte Carlo 2012: Nadal v Djokovic
programme.desc: Rafael Nadal won his eighth consecutive Monte-Carlo Masters, from 2005 to 2012, with victory over storied rival Novak Djokovic.

programme.title: I've Fallen For You
programme.desc: With the news of his parents breaking-up, Alex Boy has to do everything to achieve what he has always wanted; to live in one place as a family together. Alex Girl has set goals for herself and her family. She has to pass UP and get a job later to help her crumbling family.

programme.title: Para Sa Hopeless Romantic
programme.desc: A student writer struggles to find a happy ending for her romantic story when her own real life romance falls apart.

programme.title: Wag Kang Lilingon
programme.desc: Wag Kang Lilingon is a twin-bill horror movie In the first story \"Uyayi,\" Anne plays Melissa, a young nurse with a bright future ahead of her. But will the future turn to her favor as strange and violent events occur at the hospital she works for. Together with her boyfriend James, they try to uncover the killer behind the rising number of deaths among the patients in the hospital. In the second story \"Salamin,\" Kristine plays Angel, a beautiful young family breadwinner whose only aspiration is to see her family live a better life. When her father left her and her mother and younger sister for another woman, Angel decided to move into a new place. Little did they know the danger that lies ahead. As she discovers an old mirror, she makes a wish at the stroke of midnight by the candlelight-to know her future.

programme.title: Starting Over Again
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Ginny, an Architecture student, and Marco, a History professor, began a one-of-a-kind and unpredictable love story. In the five years that they were together, they brought out the best in each other, which included Marco’s unrealized dream of becoming a chef. Together, they worked towards their dream of opening up a restaurant, but when Ginny realized her own pursuits were different from his, she rejected his wedding proposal and left the country for a Masters degree in Architecture. At present, Ginny co-owns a one-stop Architecture and Interior Design firm specializing in Restoration. She receives an email from Marco, which was written and sent after their break-up, meant to be read four years later. It makes her feel even more regretful of leaving the love of her life.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: Covert security company Vanguard is the last hope of survival for an accountant after he is targeted by the world's deadliest mercenary organization.
